title: gesneria calycosa
intro: Gesneria calycosa, commonly known as the Calyca, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Gesneria calycosa include its ability to act as an antipyretic, helping to reduce fever, and as an antiseptic, preventing the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
